dogecoin.text:
Superfun #dogecoin episode with @AdamBLevine, who finds similarities between the meme-coin and Bitcoin.

Why is Doge so popular? What role does it play in crypto? 

Host @btschiller is joined by new cohosts, CoinDesk writers @baidakova & @realDannyNelson… https://t.co/TFVvrB0BIM

Dogecoin will never be what #bitcoin is or aspires to be, but in this unique convergence of memes, a fun brand, a strong community and marketing clout, we see how the 21st-century digital media economy is reconceptualizing money.

#MoneyReimagined https://t.co/dbzT8hUqgF
